import json

# Givens (None = not stated; closed-world: unstated facts are not derivable)
facts = {
    "ant_negotiates_stork": True,
    "dalmatian_trades_stork": False,   # "dalmatian does not trade ... with the stork"
    "stork_money": 98,
    "walrus_money": None,              # not stated
    "mouse_hugs_dinosaur": None,       # not stated
    "mouse_in_africa": None,           # "Nigeria" not stated as Africa; only feeds Rule4 -> Rule5 path
    "mouse_works_agriculture": None,   # not stated
}

def derivable_true(v):
    return v is True

# Rule1: ant deals with stork AND dalmatian does not trade with stork -> stork builds plant
r1_fires = derivable_true(facts["ant_negotiates_stork"]) and facts["dalmatian_trades_stork"] is False

# Rule3 (preferred over Rule1): stork has more money than walrus -> stork does NOT build plant
# Walrus money is unstated, so this cannot be established.
r3_fires = facts["walrus_money"] is not None and facts["stork_money"] > facts["walrus_money"]

stork_builds_plant = r1_fires and not r3_fires

# Rule2: if at least one animal builds a plant -> mouse does NOT shout at beetle
mouse_not_shout_beetle = stork_builds_plant

# Rule4: mouse in Africa -> mouse smiles at cobra (Africa unstated; Nigeria not mapped to Africa)
mouse_smiles_cobra = None
if facts["mouse_in_africa"] is True:
    mouse_smiles_cobra = True
# Rule7 (preferred over Rule4): agriculture -> not smiles at cobra (unstated)
if facts["mouse_works_agriculture"] is True:
    mouse_smiles_cobra = False

# Rule5 (preferred over Rule2): hugs dinosaur AND smiles at cobra -> shouts at beetle
mouse_shouts_beetle_positive = (
    facts["mouse_hugs_dinosaur"] is True and mouse_smiles_cobra is True
)

if mouse_shouts_beetle_positive:
    final_answer = "proved"
elif mouse_not_shout_beetle:
    final_answer = "disproved"
else:
    final_answer = "unknown"

evidence = {
    "stork_builds_plant": stork_builds_plant,
    "rule3_blocks_stork": r3_fires,
    "mouse_not_shout_beetle_via_rule2": mouse_not_shout_beetle,
    "rule5_positive_derivable": mouse_shouts_beetle_positive,
    "mouse_hugs_dinosaur_known": facts["mouse_hugs_dinosaur"] is not None,
}

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final_answer, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
